imported_for: key rotation by re-issuance and prior-version retention
companion_imports.reason: The mandatory Request-Signature in -10 is verified under agent_public_key, which is defined in this companion.

grouping_label_semantics: Experiment-only organizational labels, kept separate from the Principal Binding C-001 through C-014 claim identifiers.
permitted_conclusion_semantics: Human-readable review constraint only; it carries no stable Principal Binding accepted-result or row-result object.
profile: Base AGTP-10 Level 2 path: signed identity document, Request-Signature, Delegation-Chain verification, Governance Token action digest, EXECUTE, Attribution-Records, and optional RATS evidence. Imports draft-hood-agtp-identity-document-00 only for agent_public_key, its freshness rules, and its rotation and prior-version retention rules, because the mandatory request signature in -10 depends on them. All other companions stay excluded: AGTP-CERT, AGTP-LOG, AGTP-TRUST, AGTP-IDENTIFIERS, AGTP-COMPOSITION, and AGTP-DISCOVERY.

results.diagnostic: The declared Agent-ID resolves to a valid signed document and the signature is fresh, but it verifies under a key other than the document's agent_public_key, so the request is refused before dispatch.
results.permitted_conclusion: The request was refused because its signature does not verify under the agent_public_key the trusted document names for agtp:sha256:agent-a.
prohibited_conclusions: The live presenter is authenticated as agtp:sha256:agent-a.
A fresh, well-formed Request-Signature proves possession whatever key produced it.
results.title: Wrong Presenter

results.diagnostic: Every hop signature verifies, but the 9.3 checks find a hop that fails on inputs the verifier holds, so the request is refused with the failing hop named.
results.permitted_conclusion: Hop 1 names mail:send, which its parent hop never held, so the chain is invalid and the request is refused.
prohibited_conclusions: A hop signed by a valid parent key may widen scope.
Membership of mail:send in the origin grant repairs a widened later hop.
results.title: Widened Delegation Hop

results.diagnostic: A check cannot run because an input is unavailable; the outcome is carried as incomplete, kept apart from a refusal, and denied by default.
results.permitted_conclusion: The lifecycle state of agent-b could not be resolved, so the chain is indeterminate and the request is denied by default.
prohibited_conclusions: An indeterminate chain is a valid chain.
An unreachable registry is the same outcome as a refused chain.
results.title: Unreachable Delegation Registry

results.diagnostic: 455 when the request exceeds what the signed document grants; 262 when the missing scope is one the document grants and the agent could add to its claim.
results.permitted_conclusion: The request claims mail:send, which the signed document never granted, so it is refused with 455.
prohibited_conclusions: A claimed Authority-Scope adds authority the signed document lacks.
The refusal could equally be reported as 262.
results.title: Claimed Scope Beyond Grant

results.diagnostic: 455 when the request exceeds what the signed document grants; 262 when the missing scope is one the document grants and the agent could add to its claim.
results.permitted_conclusion: The agent holds documents:summarize in its signed document but left it out of its claim, so the request receives 262 and may be re-sent with the scope claimed.
prohibited_conclusions: An obtainable but unclaimed scope is a scope violation reported with 455.
results.title: Granted Scope Left Unclaimed

results.diagnostic: Distinct signatures and a checkable execution environment do not establish that the verifier is outside the executor's organizational control.
results.permitted_conclusion: The signed record and evidence are checkable, but AGTP-10 does not establish that their verifier is organizationally independent.
prohibited_conclusions: Different signing keys prove independent control.
RATS evidence makes the party appraising it organizationally independent.
results.title: Same-Control Verifier

results.diagnostic: The attribution record is intact, but its optional evidence cannot be established as current or appraised; signature success does not repair that missing result.
results.permitted_conclusion: The Attribution-Record and result hash are intact, but the referenced execution evidence could not be established as current or appraised.
prohibited_conclusions: Unverifiable evidence was rejected on its merits.
A valid Attribution-Record signature proves the referenced evidence was successfully appraised.
A fresh Governance Token makes completion evidence fresh.
results.title: Stale/Unverifiable Completion

results.diagnostic: Identity, signature, scope, and token checks pass, and the token's action_digest no longer matches the request as received, so the swap is refused before dispatch.
results.permitted_conclusion: The carried payload differs from the one the token's action_digest covers, so the request is refused before dispatch.
prohibited_conclusions: A matching action label proves the carried payload was authorized.
Detecting the payload swap establishes continuity from the originating A2A task.
results.title: A2A to MCP Payload Swap

results.diagnostic: The action_digest matches because the originating task identifier sits outside its inputs; the Border reference binds the task and detects the substitution.
results.permitted_conclusion: The token and payload checks pass; whether this request continues the A2A task the authority was issued for stays indeterminate under AGTP-10.
prohibited_conclusions: A matching action_digest proves the request belongs to the authorized task.
results.title: A2A Task Substitution
